messages.subject: Population Assignment Tutorial
parts:
Hi again,

I am pleased to announce another tutorial you might find of interest, on population assignment. As with many of our tutorials, it is a SandPit, designed to allow you to play with your data in dartRverse and get a feel for it before using more definitive software available from third parties. That said, it performs very well.

http://georges.biomatix.org/storage/app/media/tutorials/Tutorial_3_Population_Assignment.pdf

We hope you enjoy it. Feedback most welcome.

Arthur
